name: Commissioning handover inhibit interface
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Identifies the documented condition preventing automatic operation during a controlled handover state.
description: Identifies the documented condition preventing automatic operation during a controlled handover state. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Handover mode status” at the input and “Automatic-operation inhibit” at the output. Its scope must be explicitly defined.
